placement.placementAuditNote: NIRF 2025 UG 4-year batch graduating 2023-24: 1,100 graduated, 266 to higher studies, 590 placed of 834 eligible. Median Rs 900,000. Headline CTC: Official 2023-24 documents conflict, so the lower figure is used (D-23): Annual Report 2023-24 states 61.00 LPA ('till now', mid-year wording); the T&P Cell Placement Statistics 2023-24 (UG max, Computer Engineering) and Convocation Souvenir 2024 p.18 state 64.28 lakh. Brochure 2023-24 shows 62.75 LPA but is 2022-23 season data and is not used.

fees.tuitionAnnual.locator: B.Tech 2026-30 fee structure, table 'General, OBC & EWS, annual family income greater than 5 lakhs' (scanned; line items sum to printed triple-seater total 721,800); hostel notice CW/NK/2026/114 item 3. Mandatory = recurring 29,500/yr (medical 2,000, student activity 12,200, institute dev 7,800, career dev 1,600, exam 3,600, campus amenities 1,200, entrepreneurship 1,100) + one-time non-refundable 17,100 (alumni 2,700, welfare 1,100, admission 1,800, watch&ward 6,200, convocation 2,600, library 700, lab 2,000)/4 = 4,275. Hostel = seat rent 44,000 + triple-room usage 35,200 over 4 yrs (19,800/yr) + HDMF 6,000 one-time/4 = 1,500 + mess advance 30,000x2 + electricity advance 4,500x2; refundable security excluded. Triple room used (cheapest). Scanned figures, flagged for spot-check
